about.title: Kingsburg Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription:
When a death on Mountain View Avenue or Sierra Street takes a parent, spouse or child, the paperwork that follows can feel impossible. Kingsburg is a small town of about 11,800 people in Fresno County, and in 2025 public records list 20 injury collisions, 30 people hurt and 2 traffic deaths.

A California wrongful death claim is a civil action. It runs separately from any criminal case, and it exists so surviving relatives can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the harder-to-measure loss of love, companionship and guidance. Standing is limited: a spouse or registered domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The filing window is two years from the date of death, and it shrinks considerably when a public agency is involved.

LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. We match Kingsburg families with an independent attorney who works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on Mountain View Avenue in Kingsburg. Does it matter that no one was charged?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and does not depend on a criminal case being opened or won. The attorney you're connected with will look at the collision report, witness accounts and insurance coverage on their own. Kingsburg's collision records are public, and an attorney can request them for you.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children have the first right to file. If there are none, certain financially dependent relatives and other heirs may qualify. Because the rules are specific, it helps to have an attorney confirm standing before the claim is prepared.

items.question: How long do we have, and does LawProactive charge anything?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death, but if a government entity is involved the deadline can be a matter of months. LawProactive is free and is not a law firm; we simply connect you with an independent attorney. That attorney works on contingency, meaning there is no fee unless there is a recovery.
